coaching.headline: Lt. Belica's rotation kills and Crunch's six major takes decided the game; Revenant farming Kira and Zinx was the biggest leak.

flags.text: Lt. Belica, a damn wrecking ball: 12 kills after the only death, 6 on other lanes.
Crunch took Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth, Mini Prime, Genesis Core and two Fangtooth: every allied major but one.
Structures went 7 to 2 with no allied inhibitor lost; enemy objective damage totaled just 1131.
Revenant scored 11 kills, 5 on Kira, 3 on Zinx: more than the other four enemies combined.

focus.title: Starve Revenant, keep the clock
focus.action: When Revenant shows on the duo lane, Kira and Zinx trade only with Aurora or Crunch close by; everywhere else, keep pairing Lt. Belica's rotation kills with Crunch's objective takes.

17.2.call: Lost 0-2: after Crunch took Mini Prime, Revenant killed Zinx and Kira on the duo lane in the allied half, then Kaelen took Genesis Core. After a Prime take, the duo waits for the group before trading.

22.7.call: Won 4-1 with Fangtooth still up: Lt. Belica took the first kill on The Fey, Kira finished Narbash and Revenant, then took Fangtooth. The one cashed fight; repeat the fight-then-pit order.

31.2.call: Two separate plays: Lt. Belica and Kira each took a kill, then Revenant killed Zinx and Aurora on the enemy side. With Crunch dead and the mid inhibitor down, back out and reset.

ff5b321a-db34-46e1-bbd7-0ea8e013a407: 51365 objective damage, the most of all ten players, plus the enemy duo outer tower. When the enemy jungler is dead, keep turning the timer into a pit or tower.
Two deaths outside detected fights: Akeron in the enemy jungle, The Fey on mid, the second leaving the map 4v5. Check enemy laners before entering enemy ground.
54df9419-dc1f-4ae0-823b-791503905adb: 20224 healing and 4 wards cleared covered the support job, but 10 wards placed trailed Narbash's 14. Next game, match the enemy support's ward count before the first Prime.
Died first in 3 fights; 3 of 4 deaths to Revenant. When Revenant goes in on Kira, hold Ricochet's stun for Revenant; Tainted Charm adds tenacity if deaths repeat.
742b5ed5-ec1c-4aaa-bd28-7c741273fba7: Finished the enemy mid inhibitor and soaked 56564 mitigated damage, the allied high. No magical armor while taking 12777 magical damage: add magical armor when three magical enemies repeat.
Akeron played as the bigger tank at 2549 mitigated a minute. When all five are up at an objective, open with Cryoseism so Seismic Assault chains the stun.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: 1440 hero damage a minute against a usual 771, nearly double; 5 rotation kills on the offlane. Once the enemy mid outer falls, keep making offlane rotations.
The only death: Kaelen on the mid lane in the allied half, outside any detected fight, before minute 10. When Kaelen has not shown, hold the lane under tower.
Razed the enemy offlane outer after the Kaelen kill on the offlane. When a rotation kill lands beside a standing tower, hit the tower before backing.
11f3053a-6964-4a56-a3e9-fefe07c1c0cf: Five of six deaths went to Revenant. Dodge the Scar orb, since the orb sets up the root, and if Revenant keeps getting the kill, buy Equinox for tenacity.
8 kills, 5 on Narbash, plus 20225 objective damage, second only to Crunch on the allied side. When Lt. Belica opens a fight, follow up on the nearest target.

matchup: Jungle duel with Kaelen, a tank carrying the Rimefang stun plus Winter's Pursuit and Frostfall roots.
Crunch's record into Kaelen is 45.5% over 309 games; Revenant, the enemy threat, made 2 of 4 kills on Crunch.
build: Scattershot, Sky Splitter, Syonic Echo and Terminus: an attack-speed and lifesteal line with no Berserker's Axe core item.
Sky Splitter's on-hit damage takes a share of current health, useful into the tanky Kaelen and Akeron.
Terminus, finished last, turns lifesteal overhealing into a shield; earlier fights lacked Terminus.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage to that target, less damage taken from that target.
Pilow is the clear Best Crunch jungle Eternal; Thraex ranks near the bottom. Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the top Thraex pair.
augment: Combo Crunch stacks attack speed whenever Cross Crunch deals damage.
Combo Crunch and Lunge Crunch are a toss-up in the jungle field, so Combo Crunch is a sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active grants attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks for a short window.
Eviscerator has too few games to lead; Brutallax and Judgement are the toss-up at the top of the jungle field.
improvement: Build notes: Salvation, the tenacity answer to 3 more enemy hard-CC abilities, NOT built.
Best Crunch jungle core across matchups, Berserker's Axe, Augmentation and Tainted Blade, wins 60% over 80 games.
Pilow over Thraex is the field-backed swap: nearby enemies deal less damage after each cast, giving up the duel mark.

matchup: Duo with Kira against Revenant and Narbash; first blood went allied, and duo deaths before minute 10 ran 2 to 2.
Revenant made 3 of 4 kills on Zinx, carrying the Scar root and the Reckoning banish.
build: Marshal, Lunaria, Dynamo, Galaxy Greaves, Windcaller and Everbloom: a heal-and-buff line without Prophecy or Spectra.
Dynamo and Galaxy Greaves met the physical armor need against Revenant; Galaxy Greaves also covered magical armor into Narbash.
Everbloom, finished last, gives healed allies mitigation and tenacity; earlier fights lacked Everbloom.
eternal: Exarch gives a healed or shielded target attack speed and magical on-hit damage for a few seconds.
Weald is the clear Best Zinx support Eternal over Exarch; Revelation with Fervour is the top Exarch pair.
augment: Heal Matrix gives Infuse a second charge at reduced healing per cast.
Heal Matrix, Terminal Treatment and Disc Of Demise are a three-way toss-up, so Heal Matrix is a sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's active heals nearby heroes with brief mitigation; the passive raises the ward cap.
Tranquility is the most played support crest but trails; Pygmy Dust and Reclamation are the toss-up at the top.
improvement: Build notes: Tainted Charm, the tenacity answer to 3 more enemy hard-CC abilities, NOT built.
The field buys Tainted Totem 24% into Narbash versus 10% usually, winning 49.4% over 518 games.
Weald over Exarch is the field-backed swap: true-damage missiles on low-health heroes instead of buffing healed allies.

matchup: Offlane against Akeron, played as a tank: 81581 mitigated, twice an average offlaner's rate.
Aurora's record into Akeron is 55.6% over 110 games; Web Lash roots, knocks up and stuns.
build: Fist Of Razuul, Forticus, Vortex Stone and Tainted Guard: a full tank line instead of the Magnify and Elafrost core.
Vortex Stone pays off on immobilizing heroes with cooldown cuts and a shield, a fit for Hoarfrost and Cryoseism.
Tainted Guard, finished last, cuts healing on basic attackers; earlier fights lacked Tainted Guard.
eternal: Nihil's Doom grants power and both armors for as long as hero damage keeps Doom up.
Nihil has too few games to lead; Knell and Idrisil lead a toss-up. From the Abyss with Adaptive Plating tops Nihil pairs.
augment: Hypothermia shreds both armors and slows attack speed when Boreal Sweep hits heroes.
Hypothermia narrowly leads Glacial Thorns in a toss-up, so Hypothermia is a sound keep.
crest: Tempest's active hits 3 nearby heroes each second and heals from the damage.
Tempest is the most played offlane crest but trails; Winter's Fury and Typhoon are the toss-up at the top.
improvement: Build notes: tenacity need met by Forticus; no change proven there.
The field buys Tainted Scepter 46% into Akeron versus 33% usually, winning 52.9% over 1492 games.
Megacosm is the other Akeron adaptation: 16% into Akeron versus 8% usually, winning 53.8%.

matchup: Mid against The Fey; Lt. Belica's record into The Fey is 48.9% over 426 games.
The Fey died to Lt. Belica 4 times; Kaelen made the only kill on Lt. Belica.
build: Built all of the most played core into The Fey, Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings, plus Amulet Of Chaos.
Amulet Of Chaos cuts basic cooldowns and restores mana on takedowns, a fit for a 12-kill game.
Oblivion Crown, finished last, raises magical power by a quarter; earlier fights lacked Oblivion Crown.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat gain every 2 minutes and on every takedown.
Lotus is the clear Best Lt. Belica mid Eternal; Early Bloom with Immaculate is the top pair, Flawless with Fragrance ran instead.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience; level 18 reached.
Combat Veteran is the clear Best Lt. Belica mid augment; keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed briefly.
Soulbearer leans first in the Lt. Belica mid crest field; keep.
improvement: Build notes list no unmet need, and the core into The Fey was complete; no item change proven.
Early Bloom with Immaculate over Flawless with Fragrance: an extra level at 12 and damage reduction at high health.

matchup: Duo with Zinx against Revenant and Narbash; first blood was Kira on Narbash.
Kira's record into Revenant is 49.3% over 404 games; Revenant dealt 37160 physical damage to heroes.
build: Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator are the most played core into Revenant, plus Tainted Rounds.
Tainted Rounds, finished last, cuts healing on basic-attack hits; earlier fights lacked anti-heal from Kira.
Revenant's penetration let about 23% more physical damage through the armor held, an estimate at level 17.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below 30% health.
Lotus leans first over Weald in the Kira carry field; Dryad's Boon with Wind-Rider is the top Weald pair, Forage ran instead.
augment: Lenore makes Shadow Glide refresh Nevermore's cooldown and adds bonus damage to Nevermore.
Bringer Of Mercy and Lenore are a toss-up in the carry field, so Lenore is a sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger on low-health targets, recast on hero kills.
Pacifier leans first in the Kira carry crest field; keep.
improvement: Build notes: Equinox for tenacity NOT built; physical armor against Revenant also NOT built.
Equinox adds a shield below 40% health on top of tenacity.
The core into Revenant matched the most played one at 48.5% over 68 games; no core change proven.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
ourKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
ourKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

ourKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
ourKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
ourKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
ourKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
ourKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
ourKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
ourKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
enemyKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
enemyKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
enemyKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
enemyKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
enemyKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,194 hero damage a minute, more than 77% of Revenant carry players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Imperator.
Revenant dealt 38,196 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +220 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Kira (level 17 estimated: about 111 physical armor, 71 after penetration) and Zinx (level 17 estimated: about 165 physical armor, 111 after penetration) that is about 23% and 25% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.

Sustain: 15% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 4,289 healing recorded.

Lesson: Revenant's penetration cut through: Kira took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 111, about 71 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Demolisher. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Zinx, Aurora). Anti-heal on Aurora, Kira. We killed Revenant 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Revenant carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 1,768 damage mitigated a minute, more than 98% of Aurora offlane players this patch.
Cryoseism at top rank: 110s base, about 79.7s by the end (28% shorter) from 38 ability haste: Fist Of Razuul 20, Vortex Stone 10, Tainted Guard 8.
Aurora dealt 28,392 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +0 magical power from items.
Fist Of Razuul (item): When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.
Fist Of Razuul (item): Deal 25% increased damage to Minions.
Forticus (item): Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.
Forticus (item): Upon damaging or being damaged by Heroes: For the next 3s, gain Stats each second: (+0.6% Base Health) additional Max Health, +4 Movement Speed and +0.5% Size.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.

Sustain: Fist Of Razuul: When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.; Forticus: Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.; Forticus: Shield Activations: Hero Combat Time:; Vortex Stone: On Immobilizing Heroes: Reduce your Current Basic Ability Cooldowns by 20%. Gain a (+12%) Shield for 4s. Shield is reduced by 50% for Ranged Heroes.; 6,271 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1500 health, +110 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 49,091 damage, mitigated 56,564, died 2 times.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Fist Of Razuul, Forticus, Vortex Stone. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Fist Of Razuul, Tainted Guard.
Countered? We killed Aurora 2 times.
Copy it? Too few Aurora offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Cryoseism came back about every 80s instead of 110s by the end (28% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,440 hero damage a minute, more than 92% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch (31% of the team's). The damage came from Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Noxia.
Neural Disruptor at top rank: 85s base, about 70.8s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Noxia 20.
15 takedowns (12 kills, 3 assists) fed: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish).
Lt. Belica dealt 46,081 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +490 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Amulet Of Chaos 11; against The Fey (level 17 estimated: about 47 magical armor, 16 after penetration) and Kaelen (level 17 estimated: about 58 magical armor, 27 after penetration) that is about 27% and 24% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: The Fey took about 27% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 47, about 16 after 31 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Noxia. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 20 ability haste brought them back 17% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Akeron). Anti-heal on Akeron. We killed Lt. Belica 1 time.
Copy it? Too few Lt. Belica midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

duoLane.firstBlood: us (kira on narbash, in the duo lane)

evidence: 12/1/3, 46081 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 1440 vs their Lt. Belica norm 771.

bullets: Fate's final round always critically strikes, so Imperator's harder critical strikes landed every reload, on top of Hellfire Rounds' bonus damage from the target's missing health.
Xyris added capped damage growing with unit kills; Bone Collector's critical chance after enough unit kills raised Bounty Hunter's power; Iron Will healed more off Fate's critical strikes.
Scar's marks pulled Obliterate's missiles onto one target, and using up every Scar stack Rooted that target briefly, leaving room for more Hand Cannon rounds.
Basic attacks set off Sky Splitter's current-health damage, and on a short cooldown Scattershot's two extra projectiles, carrying on-hit effects at 50% to the closest enemies.
Thraex's mark raised damage to, and cut damage from, the hero Crunch last basic attacked; Savage Strikes added healing on-hit damage; Ferocity's hero-fight attack speed fed Sky Splitter.
Cross Crunch made the basic attack after each ability deal bonus magical damage and cut current cooldowns by 1s, and Re-Crunch could repeat the last ability used.
Nihil's Doom grew power and armor as Boreal Sweep and Frost Storm hit heroes; From the Abyss healed in hero combat; Adaptive Plating stacked capped armor when hit.
Hoarfrost's root and Cryoseism's stun set off Vortex Stone, on a cooldown, for a shield and shorter basic ability cooldowns, and cut Frozen Simulacrum's cooldown by 4s.
Fist Of Razuul built toward an empowered basic attack, Forticus shielded Aurora on hero damage, then cooled down, and Tainted Guard cut healing on enemies basic attacking Aurora.
Each ability hit could set off Combustion's blast on the target and nearby enemies, on a cooldown, and Wraith Leggings added ability damage on heroes below 40% health.
Noxia marked heroes hit by one ability; hitting a marked hero with a different ability, like Void Bomb then Seismic Assault, added 6% maximum-health damage, on a cooldown.
Lotus granted boosts periodically and on takedowns; Flawless healed Lt. Belica and nearby allies once per cast on hero hits; Fragrance raised Void Bomb damage on close heroes.
